- `workflow.call(name, init)` — dispatches to a co-located handler named in system.json. Returns `{ ok: boolean, status: number, statusText: string, body: string, headers: {...}, json(): unknown, text(): string }`.
- `workflow.saga(steps)` — runs an ordered array of `{ name, run, compensate }` steps, returns outcome object including which steps compensated when a later one fails.
- ZTS509: call/saga/fanout/follow must be at step depth 0 inside run(), never inside step().
- ZTS510: non-last saga steps must have compensate.

The user wants:
- handler in handler.ts using zttp:workflow saga() for reserve, charge, ship steps
- run key from the idempotency-key header, reading no request body
- Each step dispatches to co-located handler with call(): reserve → "inventory" at /reserve; charge → "billing" at /charge; ship → "shipping" at /ship

```ts
import { run } from "zttp:durable";
import { call, saga } from "zttp:workflow";

structural WorkflowProof<T> = Proof<T, ...>;

export function handler(req: Request): WorkflowProof<Response> {
  const key = req.headers.get("idempotency-key");
  if (key === undefined) {
    return Response.json({ error: "missing idempotency-key header" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  return run(key, () => {
    const outcome = saga([
      {
        name: "reserve",
        run: () => call("inventory", { path: "/reserve" }),
        compensate: () => call("inventory", { path: "/release" }),
      },
      {
        name: "charge",
        run: () => call("billing", { path: "/charge" }),
        compensate: () => call("billing", { path: "/refund" }),
      },
      {
        name: "ship",
        run: () => call("shipping", { path: "/ship" }),
      },
    ]);
    return Response.json({ outcome: outcome });
  });
}
```
